title: do_kdf pre-lock validation exits skip inbuf_clear
description: Trigger: user writes IKM bytes to an UNSET fd, then calls DO_KDF with invalid parameters that trigger the pre-lock validation exit (out_zero). Failing cases: ikm_fd != -1 (line 1728-1731), nonzero _pad (line 1733-1737), algo/out_algo empty (line 1695-1698), okm_len invalid (1700-1707), salt_len/info_len out of range, hkdf iterations != 0. Bad outcome: ioctl returns -EINVAL via out_zero without ever acquiring state->lock, so inbuf_clear() is never called. Sensitive IKM bytes written by the user remain in state->inbuf. The FIPS 140-3 zeroization requirement applies as soon as IKM enters the kernel; it must be destroyed on every failure path, not just the in-lock paths.
